story: As a renter I filter student rooms by price and area so I find one near campus.
As a renter I send an inquiry on a flat so the owner can contact me.
As an owner I post a listing with photos, price and location.
As an owner I edit or deactivate my commercial listing.
As an agent I manage listings for several owners from one dashboard (Phase 2).
As a service provider I list my repair service with a price from.
As an admin I review reported listings and hide or restore them.
As a renter I report a suspicious commercial listing.
